sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查出了她的名字：艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: The main thoroughfare of O'Connell Street in the heart of Dublin was bustling with foot traffic on the afternoon of Thursday, October 10, 2013.
sentences.zh: 2013年10月10日，星期四下午，位于都柏林市中心的奥康奈尔街（O'Connell Street）主干道上人来人往，十分繁忙。

sentences.en: Even though it was a cold day, tourists were ambling along the wide footpaths, taking in the city's sights and sounds while office workers hurried by them.
sentences.zh: 尽管天气寒冷，游客们仍漫步在宽阔的人行道上，欣赏着城市的风景，聆听着城市的喧嚣，而上班族们则匆匆从他们身边走过。

sentences.en: Everything about the scene was entirely typical for the setting, with one exception.
sentences.zh: 这里的一切景象都非常典型，只有一个例外。

sentences.en: A young girl who was all alone appeared to be in a distressed state.
sentences.zh: 一名独自一人的年轻女孩看起来状态十分不安。

sentences.en: She looked to be a teenager and was dressed in dark jeans, a purple hoodie with a grey woolen jumper over the top, and flat black shoes.
sentences.zh: 她看起来像个十几岁的青少年，穿着深色牛仔裤、一件紫色连帽衫，外面套着一件灰色羊毛衫，脚上穿着平底黑鞋。

sentences.en: She stood at about 5 foot 6 and had a slim build and long blonde hair as well as braces on her teeth.
sentences.zh: 她身高约5英尺6英寸（约1.68米），身材苗条，留着长长的金发，牙齿上还戴着牙套。

sentences.en: Most notably, she was obviously shivering and seemed to be crying.
sentences.zh: 最引人注目的是，她明显在发抖，似乎还在哭泣。

sentences.en: As she gazed around with fearful, timid eyes, her skin had a washed out pallor.
sentences.zh: 她用恐惧而胆怯的眼神四处张望，皮肤呈现出一种苍白的病态。

sentences.en: The girl wandered along O'Connell Street, coming to a stop outside of the central post office, an imposing Greek revival-style building that is the principal post office of Dublin.
sentences.zh: 女孩沿着奥康奈尔街徘徊，最终停在了中央邮局（GPO）外，那是一座宏伟的希腊复兴式建筑，也是都柏林的主要邮局。

sentences.en: Built in 1814, it features six fluted ionic columns along the front and three ornamental statues on top of its roof.
sentences.zh: 它建于1814年，正面有六根凹槽爱奥尼柱，屋顶上矗立着三座装饰性雕像。

sentences.en: Its striking appearance has made the GPO building a landmark for Dubliners and tourists alike.
sentences.zh: 其引人注目的外观使GPO大楼成为了都柏林人和游客共同的地标。

sentences.en: The teenage girl stood between the building's columns, looking distraught.
sentences.zh: 这名少女站在大楼的柱子之间，看起来心烦意乱。

sentences.en: Passers-by were beginning to notice her, including two uniformed officers of the Garda-Shirkhana Island's National Police who were patrolling the area.
sentences.zh: 路人开始注意到她，其中包括两名正在该地区巡逻的爱尔兰和平卫队（Garda）制服警员。

sentences.en: The officers approached the young girl and asked her what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 警员们走近女孩，询问她出了什么事。

sentences.en: The girl either couldn't or wouldn't reply.
sentences.zh: 女孩要么是不能，要么是不愿回答。

sentences.en: The officers asked if she needed help.
sentences.zh: 警员们问她是否需要帮助。

sentences.en: Again, she said nothing.
sentences.zh: 她依然一言不发。

sentences.en: Using hand gestures, she indicated that she was experiencing pain in her abdomen.
sentences.zh: 她用手势示意自己的腹部感到疼痛。

sentences.en: She also held up her fingers to explain that she was 14 years old.
sentences.zh: 她还伸出手指，表示自己今年14岁。

sentences.en: The officers wondered if perhaps the girl was from overseas and couldn't speak English.
sentences.zh: 警员们猜测，这个女孩可能是从国外来的，不会说英语。

sentences.en: She didn't have any luggage on her nor any identification.
sentences.zh: 她身上既没有行李，也没有任何身份证明。

sentences.en: The officers decided that the best thing to do was to take her into custody for her own safety as she was clearly vulnerable and distraught.
sentences.zh: 警员们认为，鉴于她显然处于脆弱和不安的状态，为了她的安全，最好的办法是将她带回警局保护起来。

sentences.en: The girl was taken to the nearby children's hospital on Temple Street, just a short distance from the GPO building.
sentences.zh: 女孩被送往距离GPO大楼不远的坦普尔街（Temple Street）儿童医院。

sentences.en: She was ushered into a cubicle in the emergency department with the curtain pulled around for privacy.
sentences.zh: 她被带进急诊室的一个隔间，帘子被拉上以保护隐私。

sentences.en: Physicians examined her while a detective arrived to speak to the girl as well.
sentences.zh: 医生为她进行了检查，一名侦探也赶来与她交谈。

sentences.en: She appeared to be in good health, aside from being somewhat emaciated.
sentences.zh: 除了有些消瘦外，她的身体状况看起来还不错。

sentences.en: What was more concerning was her behaviour.
sentences.zh: 更令人担忧的是她的行为。

sentences.en: Although she was polite, she was clearly uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 虽然她很有礼貌，但显然很不自在。

sentences.en: She hid her face behind the long strands of her blonde hair and averted her gaze whenever anyone tried to make eye contact.
sentences.zh: 她用长长的金发遮住脸，每当有人试图与她进行眼神交流时，她都会避开目光。

sentences.en: The girl also remained entirely non-verbal, no matter who spoke to her.
sentences.zh: 无论谁跟她说话，女孩始终保持沉默，一言不发。

sentences.en: She was questioned for hours, but never said a word.
sentences.zh: 她被盘问了几个小时，却始终没有说出一个字。

sentences.en: Nurses who spoke languages other than English were brought in to try talking with her, to no avail.
sentences.zh: 院方找来了会说其他语言的护士试图与她沟通，但都无济于事。

sentences.en: Eventually, she found a way to communicate.
sentences.zh: 最终，她找到了一种交流方式。

sentences.en: The girl began drawing pictures on a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 女孩开始在一张纸上画画。

sentences.en: They were rudimentary illustrations with stick figures representing people.
sentences.zh: 那是一些简陋的插图，用火柴人代表人物。

sentences.en: First, she drew herself on an aeroplane, suggesting she had flown to Ireland.
sentences.zh: 首先，她画了自己坐飞机的样子，暗示她是乘飞机来到爱尔兰的。

sentences.en: She also sketched an image of a gun and another of a crucifix.
sentences.zh: 她还画了一把枪和十字架的草图。

sentences.en: When she drew a bed with a girl on top of it, surrounded by men standing all around her, one of the nurses began to cry.
sentences.zh: 当她画出一张床上躺着一个女孩，周围站满了男人的画面时，其中一名护士开始哭泣。

sentences.en: Over the next few days, the GPO girl, as she came to be known, was moved from her cubicle to a private room elsewhere in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天里，这个被称为“GPO女孩”的女孩被从隔间转移到了医院里的一个私人房间。

sentences.en: Whenever anyone attempted to touch her, she would physically recoil from the contact.
sentences.zh: 每当有人试图触碰她时，她都会因身体接触而本能地退缩。

sentences.en: Doctors and the police alike suspected that she had been sexually abused, perhaps even exploited.
sentences.zh: 医生和警察都怀疑她曾遭受过性虐待，甚至可能遭到过剥削。

sentences.en: Certainly, her drawings seemed to suggest she had been trafficked to Ireland for sexual exploitation purposes.
sentences.zh: 当然，她的画作似乎暗示她是为了性剥削目的而被贩卖到爱尔兰的。

sentences.en: Her clothing was forensically examined for signs of sexual assault, and although these tests returned negative, this did little to allay concerns.
sentences.zh: 她的衣物经过了法医检查以寻找性侵迹象，尽管检测结果呈阴性，但这并没有减轻人们的担忧。

sentences.en: While physicians did their best not to exacerbate the girl's trauma, the story of the mystery girl found in central Dublin made headlines,
sentences.zh: 虽然医生们尽最大努力不加重女孩的创伤，但这个在都柏林市中心发现的神秘女孩的故事还是登上了头条，

sentences.en: and the subject of human trafficking became a national talking point.
sentences.zh: 人口贩卖问题也成为了全国讨论的焦点。

sentences.en: The GPO girl's identity was a total mystery.
sentences.zh: GPO女孩的身份完全是个谜。

sentences.en: She still wasn't speaking, but she did appear to at least understand some English.
sentences.zh: 她依然不说话，但看起来至少能听懂一些英语。

sentences.en: It was speculated that she may have been flown from Eastern Europe to Ireland by an organised crime gang, or at least one criminal who held her under total control.
sentences.zh: 据推测，她可能是被有组织犯罪团伙，或者至少是一个完全控制她的罪犯，从东欧空运到爱尔兰的。

sentences.en: A police guard was maintained outside of her hospital room at all times, and a female liaison officer was appointed to handle the delicate nature of the GPO girl's case.
sentences.zh: 她的病房外始终有警察守卫，并指派了一名女性联络官来处理GPO女孩案件的敏感性问题。

sentences.en: The girl was also given a guardian named Orla Ryan, who shared that she was extremely concerned about the welfare circumstances of this young person.
sentences.zh: 女孩还被指定了一名监护人奥拉·瑞安（Orla Ryan），她表示对这位年轻人的福利状况感到极其担忧。

sentences.en: The guarder launched Operation Shepherd, their name, for the investigation into the case.
sentences.zh: 警方启动了名为“牧羊人行动”（Operation Shepherd）的调查。

sentences.en: Missing person reports were examined, but none matched the GPO girl.
sentences.zh: 警方查阅了失踪人口报告，但没有一条与GPO女孩相符。

sentences.en: People who had been in the vicinity of the GPO building on Thursday, October 10, 2013, were tracked down and interviewed, while CCTV footage from nearby cameras was reviewed.
sentences.zh: 警方追踪并采访了2013年10月10日星期四曾在GPO大楼附近的人，并查看了附近的监控录像。

sentences.en: Homelessness services, child protection agencies, and juvenile liaison officers all over Ireland were checked to see if they had any record of the girl,
sentences.zh: 全爱尔兰的无家可归者服务机构、儿童保护机构和青少年联络官都被核查过，看是否有关于该女孩的记录，

sentences.en: as were hotels and hostels, along with lockers at public transit stations and lost luggage facilities.
sentences.zh: 酒店、旅馆、公共交通站的储物柜以及行李寄存处也进行了排查。

sentences.en: Detectives reviewed plane manifests from countless flights to see if any passengers matched the description of the GPO girl and spoke extensively with airport police.
sentences.zh: 侦探们查阅了无数航班的乘客名单，看是否有乘客符合GPO女孩的特征，并与机场警察进行了广泛交流。

sentences.en: But none of these enquiries led anywhere.
sentences.zh: 但这些调查都没有任何进展。

sentences.en: In an attempt to find some record of the girl's family, guarder officers meticulously searched through recent death notices
sentences.zh: 为了寻找女孩家人的记录，警官们仔细搜查了近期的死亡公告，

sentences.en: in case her parents had recently passed, leaving her all alone.
sentences.zh: 以防她的父母最近去世，留下她孤身一人。

sentences.en: Noticing that the girl had had orthodontic work, they also reached out to dentists to check their records.
sentences.zh: 注意到女孩做过牙齿矫正，他们还联系了牙医检查记录。

sentences.en: Despite their efforts, no clues emerged that would help them identify the girl.
sentences.zh: 尽管付出了努力，但没有任何线索能帮助他们确认女孩的身份。

sentences.en: As the days turned into weeks and almost a month went by, the GPO girl remained in her hospital room.
sentences.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，几周甚至快一个月过去了，GPO女孩依然待在病房里。

sentences.en: She passed the time watching television or sometimes painting her nails, still staying silent at all times.
sentences.zh: 她靠看电视或有时涂指甲油来打发时间，始终保持沉默。

sentences.en: Although she was pleasant towards hospital staff and members of the guarder, she was also unmistakably cagey.
sentences.zh: 虽然她对医院工作人员和警员态度友好，但明显十分谨慎。

sentences.en: When officers requested to take her fingerprints in the hopes of identifying her, she refused.
sentences.zh: 当警员要求采集她的指纹以期确认身份时，她拒绝了。

sentences.en: Nor would she let them take her photo.
sentences.zh: 她也不让他们给她拍照。

sentences.en: Detectives began to resort to clandestine methods to obtain the information they needed.
sentences.zh: 侦探们开始采取秘密手段来获取所需信息。

sentences.en: First, they recovered her fingerprints after clearing a used plate from her room.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们在清理她房间里的用过的餐盘后，提取到了她的指纹。

sentences.en: However, the prints matched nothing in their systeMs.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些指纹在系统里匹配不到任何信息。

sentences.en: Next, a scheme was concocted to allow them to take a photo of the girl.
sentences.zh: 接着，他们策划了一个方案来拍摄女孩的照片。

sentences.en: She was told she would be moved to a new room, and as she was escorted from one room to another, a nearby officer managed to surreptitiously snap her picture.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉她要搬到新房间，当她被护送从一个房间到另一个房间时，附近的一名警官设法偷偷拍下了她的照片。

sentences.en: The photo was grainy in quality and only captured the girl in profile.
sentences.zh: 照片质量很模糊，只拍到了女孩的侧脸。

sentences.en: Her long hair was scraped into a messy bun on top of her head as she looked straight ahead with eyes that appeared tired with heavy bags.
sentences.zh: 她长长的头发在头顶盘成一个凌乱的发髻，双眼直视前方，看起来疲惫不堪，眼袋很重。

sentences.en: Her right hand was raised to her mouth, and she was sucking on her index finger in a childlike way as though self-soothing.
sentences.zh: 她的右手抬到嘴边，像孩子一样吮吸着食指，仿佛在自我安抚。

sentences.en: It wasn't a perfect photograph, but it captured enough of the girl's appearance that someone who knew her might be able to recognise her.
sentences.zh: 这不是一张完美的照片，但足以捕捉到女孩的样貌，认识她的人或许能认出她来。

sentences.en: Detectives sent the picture to Interpol, an international organisation that facilitates police cooperation, in the hopes they might be able to identify the girl.
sentences.zh: 侦探们将照片发给了国际刑警组织（Interpol），希望他们能协助确认女孩的身份。

sentences.en: But they couldn't.
sentences.zh: 但他们也做不到。

sentences.en: Irish detectives were growing desperate.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰侦探们感到越来越绝望。

sentences.en: Four weeks had now passed since the girl was found and all of their leads had dried up.
sentences.zh: 距离女孩被发现已经过去了四周，所有的线索都断了。

sentences.en: They began to wonder whether going public was the key to solving the mystery.
sentences.zh: 他们开始怀疑，公开信息是否是解开谜团的关键。

sentences.en: They weren't permitted to do this due to the girl's status as a minor and likely victim of crime,
sentences.zh: 由于女孩未成年且很可能是犯罪受害者，他们本不被允许这样做，

sentences.en: but perhaps the courts would grant them an exception due to the extraordinary circumstances.
sentences.zh: 但也许法院会考虑到特殊情况而给予豁免。

sentences.en: When detectives told the GPO girl of their plan, she became visibly distraught, shaking her head no at the prospect of her photo being shared.
sentences.zh: 当侦探们告诉GPO女孩他们的计划时，她明显感到心烦意乱，摇着头拒绝公开她的照片。

sentences.en: But Ireland's High Court gave permission for the picture to be published, and on Tuesday November 5, the police held a press conference at Garda headquarters.
sentences.zh: 但爱尔兰高等法院批准了照片的发布。11月5日星期二，警方在总部举行了新闻发布会。

sentences.en: As the GPO girl's photograph was held up, a Garda spokesperson beseeched the public,
sentences.zh: 当GPO女孩的照片被举起时，警方发言人恳求公众：

sentences.en: Do you recognise this girl?
sentences.zh: “你们认识这个女孩吗？”

sentences.en: Did you pass her in a distressed state in the city centre?
sentences.zh: “你们是否曾在市中心看到她处于不安的状态？”

sentences.en: Any information is vital to this investigation.
sentences.zh: “任何信息对这项调查都至关重要。”

sentences.en: A special phone line was set up for the public to call with tip-offs.
sentences.zh: 警方设立了一条专门的电话热线，供公众提供线索。

sentences.en: After the press conference wrapped, the calls started coming in.
sentences.zh: 新闻发布会结束后，电话开始涌入。

sentences.en: People rang from all over Ireland, sharing their theories and possible leads.
sentences.zh: 来自爱尔兰各地的人们打来电话，分享他们的理论和可能的线索。

sentences.en: With the press conference making international news, calls were also made from locations as far away as Cyprus and Canada.
sentences.zh: 随着新闻发布会成为国际新闻，甚至有来自塞浦路斯和加拿大等地的电话打进来。

sentences.en: Yet, none of these were helpful in identifying the GPO girl either.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些线索对确认GPO女孩的身份依然毫无帮助。

sentences.en: It was the middle of the night in Australia when the Garda held their press conference, but within a few hours of its broadcast,
sentences.zh: 警方举行新闻发布会时，澳大利亚正值深夜，但在广播播出后的几个小时内，

sentences.en: Australians were waking up to start another day.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚人开始醒来，迎接新的一天。

sentences.en: One police officer in the Western Australian capital of Perth saw the report about the GPO girl in Ireland, along with the photo of her that the Garda had shared.
sentences.zh: 西澳大利亚州首府珀斯的一名警官看到了关于爱尔兰GPO女孩的报道，以及警方分享的照片。

sentences.en: He thought it sounded remarkably similar to another case from two years earlier and much closer to home.
sentences.zh: 他觉得这听起来与两年前发生在离家更近的地方的另一桩案件惊人地相似。

sentences.en: Two years prior in 2011, a 15-year-old girl named Hope moved from New Zealand to Perth with her parents and three brothers.
sentences.zh: 两年前的2011年，一个名叫霍普（Hope）的15岁女孩随父母和三个兄弟从新西兰搬到了珀斯。

sentences.en: The international move was a big adjustment for Hope, who had grown up in a small town and now found herself living in a capital city.
sentences.zh: 这次跨国搬迁对霍普来说是一个巨大的调整，她在一个小镇长大，现在却发现自己住在一个大城市里。

sentences.en: Moreover, she found out that her home school credits from New Zealand were not recognised by the Australian authorities, so she would have to find a way to complete her education.
sentences.zh: 此外，她发现新西兰的家庭学校学分不被澳大利亚当局认可，所以她必须想办法完成学业。

sentences.en: Hope enrolled at a TAFE, a kind of vocational education and training provider in Australia.
sentences.zh: 霍普在TAFE注册入学，这是一种澳大利亚的职业教育和培训机构。

sentences.en: Unlike universities, which focus on academic study,
sentences.zh: 与侧重学术研究的大学不同，

sentences.en: TAFE suffer courses that focus on more practical, job-specific skills.
sentences.zh: TAFE提供侧重于更实用、针对具体工作的课程。

sentences.en: It is also possible to complete senior secondary studies at TAFE instead of enrolling in a high school.
sentences.zh: 也可以在TAFE完成高中学业，而不是进入普通高中。

sentences.en: Hope found it difficult to make friends in this new environment as she was shy and somewhat sheltered.
sentences.zh: 霍普发现很难在这个新环境中交到朋友，因为她性格害羞，且有些封闭。

sentences.en: Everything changed, however, when she met Emily Skaberis in July 2011.
sentences.zh: 然而，2011年7月当她遇到艾米丽·斯卡贝里斯（Emily Skaberis）时，一切都变了。

sentences.en: Emily was completing the same course as Hope, and was warm and friendly.

sentences.zh: “噢，你是说爵士·杰维斯，”工作人员回答道，然后向他们展示了一张印有这个完全陌生名字的银行卡复印件。

sentences.en: Mel and her elder daughter
sentences.zh: 梅尔和她的大女儿

sentences.en: Tiana had no idea who Jazz Jervis was or why Coco Palmer would be using her bank card.
sentences.zh: 蒂亚娜根本不知道爵士·杰维斯是谁，也不知道为什么可可·帕尔默会使用她的银行卡。

sentences.en: They googled Jazz Jervis' name and quickly found social media accounts for her.
sentences.zh: 她们在谷歌上搜索了爵士·杰维斯的名字，很快就找到了她的社交媒体账号。

sentences.en: She wasn't Coco Palmer, she was a young mother living in Melbourne with her husband and daughter.
sentences.zh: 她不是可可·帕尔默，而是一位住在墨尔本的年轻母亲，和丈夫及女儿生活在一起。

sentences.en: Her husband, Tom Jervis, was a professional basketballer who'd played for the Perth Wildcats in
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫汤姆·杰维斯是一名职业篮球运动员，曾效力于珀斯野猫队，

sentences.en: Australia's National Basketball
sentences.zh: 这是澳大利亚国家篮球

sentences.en: League.
sentences.zh: 联赛的球队。

sentences.en: Tiana sent Jazz a message on
sentences.zh: 蒂亚娜在Facebook上给爵士发了一条消息，

sentences.en: Facebook and told her what had happened.
sentences.zh: 告诉了她发生的事情。

sentences.en: Jazz saw the message quickly and knew exactly who Tiana was talking about.
sentences.zh: 爵士很快看到了这条消息，并确切地知道蒂亚娜说的是谁。

sentences.en: She sent back her own story.
sentences.zh: 她回发了自己的故事。

sentences.en: In June 2018, Jazz and Tom had been living in Brisbane and needed an au pair for their two-year-old daughter
sentences.zh: 2018年6月，爵士和汤姆住在布里斯班，需要找一位互惠生来照顾他们两岁的女儿

sentences.en: Clementine.
sentences.zh: 克莱门汀。

sentences.en: Jazz turned to a popular au pair group on Facebook to find someone and was soon contacted by another host family with a recommendation.
sentences.zh: 爵士在Facebook的一个热门互惠生群组里寻找人选，很快就收到了另一个寄宿家庭的推荐联系。

sentences.en: They had a 17-year-old au pair named
sentences.zh: 他们有一位名叫

sentences.en: Harper Hernandez who was amazing but they were moving overseas so didn't need her services anymore.
sentences.zh: 哈珀·埃尔南德斯的互惠生，她非常出色，但因为他们要搬到海外，不再需要她的服务了。

sentences.en: Harper needed a new job and the host family recommended her wholeheartedly.
sentences.zh: 哈珀需要一份新工作，那个寄宿家庭全心全意地推荐了她。

sentences.en: Delighted to have received a referral, Jazz met with Harper and liked her right away.
sentences.zh: 爵士很高兴得到了推荐，她见了哈珀，立刻就喜欢上了她。

sentences.en: Clementine adored her and it seemed like a perfect fit.
sentences.zh: 克莱门汀很爱她，这看起来是一个完美的人选。

sentences.en: Harper moved in with them and was as good as the host family had promised.
sentences.zh: 哈珀搬来和他们住在一起，表现得和那个寄宿家庭承诺的一样好。

sentences.en: She helped out around the house, was excellent with Clementine and got along well with the Jervises family and friends.
sentences.zh: 她帮忙做家务，照顾克莱门汀非常出色，与杰维斯一家及其朋友也相处融洽。

sentences.en: When the Jervises relocated to
sentences.zh: 当杰维斯一家搬到

sentences.en: Melbourne, Harper came with them.
sentences.zh: 墨尔本时，哈珀也跟着他们一起去了。

sentences.en: For about a year, all had gone well, but things eventually took a turn.
sentences.zh: 大约一年来，一切都很顺利，但最终情况发生了变化。

sentences.en: Jazz and Tom noticed that Harper was very cagey about her background and she had a tendency to lie about random things.
sentences.zh: 爵士和汤姆注意到哈珀对自己的背景非常隐瞒，而且她有对琐事撒谎的倾向。

sentences.en: When they googled her name, nothing at all came up, which seemed strange.
sentences.zh: 当他们谷歌搜索她的名字时，什么信息都没有，这看起来很奇怪。

sentences.en: Eventually, they decided to let Harper go, telling her it was no longer the right fit.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们决定辞退哈珀，告诉她这里不再适合她了。

sentences.en: She told them she intended to travel west to Perth and Tom gave her a lift to
sentences.zh: 她告诉他们她打算去西部的珀斯旅行，汤姆开车送她去了

sentences.en: Melbourne Airport on Wednesday June 19, 2019.
sentences.zh: 2019年6月19日星期三的墨尔本机场。

sentences.en: It wasn't until after she'd left that they discovered she'd stolen Jazz's driver's license and the family iPad.
sentences.zh: 直到她离开后，他们才发现她偷走了爵士的驾照和家里的iPad。

sentences.en: Harper had left some things behind as well, including several passports in different names.
sentences.zh: 哈珀还留下了一些东西，包括几本不同名字的护照。

sentences.en: Just over two weeks later, Jazz received the message from Tiana Bevidge informing her that a supposed talent scout they were working with had a bank card in her name.
sentences.zh: 仅仅两周多后，爵士收到了蒂亚娜·贝维奇的消息，告知她，他们正在合作的一位所谓星探持有她名下的银行卡。

sentences.en: Tiana and Mel were horrified to learn
sentences.zh: 蒂亚娜和梅尔在得知

sentences.en: Jazz's story, realising they had no idea who Coco Palmer really was.
sentences.zh: 爵士的故事后感到震惊，意识到她们根本不知道可可·帕尔默到底是谁。

sentences.en: They called the police to report her, only to receive little assistance.
sentences.zh: 她们打电话报警举报她，却几乎没得到什么帮助。

sentences.en: Then they called Georgia on her mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 然后她们用手机给乔治亚打了电话。

sentences.en: As Georgia was currently out alone with
sentences.zh: 由于乔治亚当时正独自和

sentences.en: Coco, they had to tread carefully.
sentences.zh: 可可在一起，她们必须小心行事。

sentences.en: They told Georgia that Coco wasn't a safe person, that she should pretend to feel sick and say she had to leave.
sentences.zh: 她们告诉乔治亚，可可不是个安全的人，让她假装不舒服并说必须离开。

sentences.en: Georgia did as she was told, and when she and Coco returned to the hostel, Mel and
sentences.zh: 乔治亚照做了，当她和可可回到旅舍时，梅尔和

sentences.en: Tiana confronted the supposed talent scout with what they knew.
sentences.zh: 蒂亚娜用她们所知道的情况与这位所谓的星探对质。

sentences.en: Tiana secretly recorded the confrontation on her phone, managing to capture some surreptitious footage of Coco.
sentences.zh: 蒂亚娜用手机秘密录下了这次对质，成功捕捉到了一些可可偷偷摸摸的画面。

sentences.en: Cagey and nervous, Coco repeatedly refused to show the family her ID, but reassured them that she had tickets for them all to fly home.
sentences.zh: 可可神情紧张、闪烁其词，反复拒绝向这家人出示身份证件，但向她们保证她已经为她们所有人买好了回家的机票。

sentences.en: She wouldn't show them or send them the tickets then and there, and when Mel began shouting at her to share her real name, Coco suddenly fled.
sentences.zh: 她当时不肯出示或发送机票，当梅尔开始大声要求她说出真实姓名时，可可突然逃跑了。

sentences.en: By the time police arrived, she was long gone.
sentences.zh: 等警察赶到时，她早已不见踪影。

sentences.en: The family flew home the next day after paying almost
sentences.zh: 这家人第二天自掏腰包花了近

sentences.en: $1,000 for tickets out of their own pocket.
sentences.zh: 1000美元买了机票飞回家。

sentences.en: When they were safely at home, Mel shared a post about the ordeal to her Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 当她们安全到家后，梅尔在她的Facebook页面上分享了一篇关于这次遭遇的帖子。

sentences.en: She attached a photo she'd taken of Coco as well as a screenshot from their secretly recorded confrontation.
sentences.zh: 她附上了一张她拍的可可的照片，以及她们秘密录下的对质视频截图。

sentences.en: To say I'm shattered and disappointed in myself is an understatement.
sentences.zh: 说我感到崩溃和对自己失望，这都算是轻的。

sentences.en: How could I be so blind to be had like that?
sentences.zh: 我怎么会如此盲目，竟然被骗成这样？

sentences.en: Mel wrote.
sentences.zh: 梅尔写道。

sentences.en: Please share this woman's face.
sentences.zh: 请分享这个女人的脸。

sentences.en: Police were no help, but I'm taking it further, as she's dangerous.
sentences.zh: 警察帮不上忙，但我会进一步追究，因为她很危险。

sentences.en: An acquaintance of Mel's soon saw the post and sent her a message.
sentences.zh: 梅尔的一位熟人很快看到了这篇帖子，并给她发了一条消息。

sentences.en: Mel, I know this woman.
sentences.zh: 梅尔，我认识这个女人。

sentences.en: Google GPO girl and you'll know what I'm talking about.
sentences.zh: 谷歌搜索“GPO女孩”，你就知道我在说什么了。

sentences.en: Mel did so, and as soon as she saw the infamous photograph of
sentences.zh: 梅尔照做了，当她看到那张臭名昭著的

sentences.en: Samantha as a party taken by Dublin police, she knew that she and Coco Palmer were one and the same.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎在都柏林被警方逮捕时的照片时，她就知道她和可可·帕尔默是同一个人。

sentences.en: Jazz Jervis also shared Mel's post, and other revelations quickly came to light as the story spread.
sentences.zh: 爵士·杰维斯也分享了梅尔的帖子，随着故事的传播，其他真相也很快浮出水面。

sentences.en: A total stranger reached out to the Jervis family to tell them
sentences.zh: 一个完全陌生的人联系了杰维斯一家，告诉他们

sentences.en: Samantha, posing as Harper Hernandez, had once left their daughter Clementine in the stranger's care for several hours.
sentences.zh: 冒充哈珀·埃尔南德斯的萨曼莎，曾经把他们的女儿克莱门汀交给这个陌生人照顾了几个小时。

sentences.en: Another Melbourne family had also fallen victim to the same scheme as Mel and a Georgia Bevidge earlier that year, when Samantha posed as a talent scout named Marley.
sentences.zh: 那年早些时候，另一个墨尔本家庭也遭遇了和梅尔及乔治亚·贝维奇同样的骗局，当时萨曼莎冒充了一个名叫马利的星探。

sentences.en: She wanted to hire their 12-year-old daughter Emma to do voiceover work in a cartoon.
sentences.zh: 她想雇佣他们12岁的女儿艾玛为一部动画片做配音工作。

sentences.en: After charming the family, she began to meet with Emma every Tuesday and asked her to do strange things.
sentences.zh: 在迷住这家人后，她开始每周二与艾玛见面，并要求她做一些奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: She had to go into shops, a hospital, and the office of a statutory authority responsible for providing Australians with social security payments,
sentences.zh: 她必须去商店、医院，以及一个负责为澳大利亚人提供社会保障金的法定机构办公室，

sentences.en: claiming to be adopted and in need of help.
sentences.zh: 声称自己是被收养的，需要帮助。

sentences.en: Marley instructed Emma not to tell her parents about any of these tasks.
sentences.zh: 马利指示艾玛不要告诉父母这些任务中的任何一项。

sentences.en: On one occasion, she had to report that she was seeing ghosts.
sentences.zh: 有一次，她不得不报告说她看到了鬼魂。

sentences.en: Things came to a terrifying head when Marley took Emma on a paid trip to Sydney, promising her an audition in the Australian version of the prank-focused television program Punk'd.
sentences.zh: 当马利带着艾玛进行了一次付费的悉尼之旅，并承诺让她在恶搞电视节目《整蛊总动员》的澳大利亚版中试镜时，事情达到了可怕的顶峰。

sentences.en: They stayed together at a ranch.
sentences.zh: 她们住在一个牧场里。

sentences.en: Emma noticed that the other people there called Marley Samantha, but when she asked her about that,
sentences.zh: 艾玛注意到那里的人叫马利为萨曼莎，但当她问起这件事时，

sentences.en: Marley refused to answer.
sentences.zh: 马利拒绝回答。

sentences.en: After two days,
sentences.zh: 两天后，

sentences.en: Marley sent Emma home on a train to Melbourne, an 11-hour journey that the 12-year-old had to make alone.
sentences.zh: 马利让艾玛独自坐火车回墨尔本，这是一段12岁的孩子必须独自完成的11小时旅程。

sentences.en: When the family subsequently confronted Marley, she disappeared.
sentences.zh: 当这家人随后与马利对质时，她消失了。

sentences.en: They could find no trace of her online.
sentences.zh: 他们在网上找不到她的任何踪迹。

sentences.en: As word got out on social media that infamous con artist Samantha Azapati was at it again while she was supposed to still be on a good behaviour bond,
sentences.zh: 随着社交媒体上传出臭名昭著的骗子萨曼莎·阿扎帕蒂在理应处于良好行为保释期内又重操旧业的消息，

sentences.en: traditional media picked up the story.
sentences.zh: 传统媒体也报道了这个故事。

sentences.en: Victoria Police commented that they were investigating reports of her alleged deception in the state.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚州警方评论说，他们正在调查有关她在该州涉嫌欺诈的报告。

sentences.en: What was most concerning was that Samantha was no longer the centre of her own scaMs.
sentences.zh: 最令人担忧的是，萨曼莎不再是她自己骗局的中心了。

sentences.en: While before she had posed as a child herself in repeated stories of abuse and suffering, now she appeared to be enlisting actual children to live out that same fantasy.
sentences.zh: 以前她自己在反复讲述受虐待和痛苦的故事中冒充孩子，现在她似乎在招募真正的孩子来演绎同样的幻想。

sentences.en: Four months later, on Friday November 1, 2019, a teenage girl wearing a blue school uniform with a blue felt hat walked into Headspace offices
sentences.zh: 四个月后，2019年11月1日星期五，一个穿着蓝色校服、戴着蓝色毡帽的十几岁女孩走进了Headspace办公室，

sentences.en: in the regional Victorian city of Bendigo, about a two-hour drive north from Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 位于维多利亚州地区城市本迪戈，距离墨尔本以北约两小时车程。

sentences.en: Headspace is a youth mental health foundation with centres all over Australia.
sentences.zh: Headspace是一个在澳大利亚各地设有中心的青少年心理健康基金会。

sentences.en: The girl wasn't alone.
sentences.zh: 这个女孩不是一个人。

sentences.en: Standing next to her was a four-year-old girl and strapped to the teenager's chest was a ten-month-old baby.
sentences.zh: 站在她旁边的是一个四岁的小女孩，而这个十几岁女孩的胸前还绑着一个十个月大的婴儿。

sentences.en: The girl told Headspace staff that she was 14 years old and pregnant.
sentences.zh: 女孩告诉Headspace的工作人员，她14岁并且怀孕了。

sentences.en: The pregnancy was the result of her abusive uncle having raped her.
sentences.zh: 这次怀孕是她虐待成性的叔叔强奸她的结果。

sentences.en: But one staff member at the centre had seen the recent social media posts about Samantha Azapati's latest deceptions and they recognised the person in front of them
sentences.zh: 但中心的一名工作人员看到了最近关于萨曼莎·阿扎帕蒂最新骗局的社交媒体帖子，他们认出了眼前的人

sentences.en: as the now 31-year-old con artiSt.
sentences.zh: 就是那个现年31岁的骗子。

sentences.en: The staff member took a photo of Samantha and called the police.
sentences.zh: 工作人员拍下了萨曼莎的照片并报了警。

sentences.en: Although detectives were quickly dispatched,
sentences.zh: 尽管侦探们很快被派往现场，

sentences.en: Samantha was still wanted by Victoria Police for her use of Jazz Jervis's stolen driver's licence.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎因使用爵士·杰维斯被盗的驾照而仍被维多利亚州警方通缉。

sentences.en: By the time they arrived,
sentences.zh: 当他们赶到时，

sentences.en: Samantha had fled with the children in tow.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎已经带着孩子们逃跑了。

sentences.en: Undeterred, the detectives headed to Bendigo's main shopping district located on a busy thoroughfare called Pal-Mal.
sentences.zh: 侦探们没有气馁，前往本迪戈的主要购物区，那里位于一条名为帕尔-马尔的繁忙大道上。

sentences.en: They located Samantha Azapati and the two children wandering along the street and she spotted them too.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了萨曼莎·阿扎帕蒂和两个孩子在街上游荡，她也发现了他们。

sentences.en: Samantha fled inside a department store and the detectives followed.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎逃进了一家百货商店，侦探们紧随其后。

sentences.en: She ducked and weaved around racks and counters as the police closed in.
sentences.zh: 当警察逼近时，她在货架和柜台间闪躲穿梭。

sentences.en: She'd made it to a cosmetics counter and was unbuckling the harness that kept the baby strapped to her chest when one of the detectives called out,
sentences.zh: 她跑到了一个化妆品柜台，正在解开把婴儿绑在胸前的背带时，其中一名侦探喊道：

sentences.en: Samantha.
sentences.zh: “萨曼莎。”

sentences.en: She stopped and stared back at him before asking,
sentences.zh: 她停下来盯着他看，然后问道：

sentences.en: Who?
Me?
sentences.zh: “我吗？”

sentences.en: Samantha Azapati was arrested and taken into custody along with the two small children.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎·阿扎帕蒂被捕，并连同两个小孩一起被拘留。

sentences.en: They appeared to speak little English, making it difficult for police to communicate with them and find out their names.
sentences.zh: 她们似乎只会说一点英语，这使得警方很难与她们沟通并查明她们的名字。

sentences.en: Meanwhile,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Samantha sat in a cell turning to face a corner and hugging her knees to her cheSt.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎坐在牢房里，转过身面对角落，双膝抱胸。

sentences.en: The detectives tried to question her but she refused to be formally interviewed, speaking only in strange riddles.
sentences.zh: 侦探们试图审问她，但她拒绝接受正式采访，只用奇怪的谜语说话。

sentences.en: She began providing cryptic clues as to the children's identity, indicating she'd met their parents via a Work Wanted ad.
sentences.zh: 她开始提供关于孩子们身份的隐晦线索，暗示她是通过一则“求职”广告认识她们父母的。

sentences.en: Eventually, detectives were able to identify the children as two sisters, the daughters of French nationals who had recently moved to Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 最终，侦探们确定了这两个孩子是两姐妹，是最近搬到墨尔本的法国公民的女儿。

sentences.en: The couple had hired Samantha as an au pair one month earlier in October and she had been living with the family.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇一个月前，即10月份雇佣了萨曼莎作为互惠生，她一直和这家人住在一起。

sentences.en: They believed her name was Sakaar, that she was 18 and a qualified childcare worker with the documents to prove it.
sentences.zh: 他们以为她的名字叫萨卡尔，18岁，是一名有资质的托儿工作者，并有文件证明这一点。

sentences.en: Earlier that morning,
sentences.zh: 那天早上早些时候，

sentences.en: Samantha had told the couple she was taking the girls on a picnic in the Yu Yangs, a mountain range and regional park about an hour southwest of the family's home in Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎告诉这对夫妇，她要带女孩们去尤杨斯野餐，那是一个山脉和区域公园，距离这家人在墨尔本的家大约一小时路程。

sentences.en: Instead, she'd taken them to Bendigo in a completely different part of the state.
sentences.zh: 相反，她把她们带到了该州完全不同地区的本迪戈。

sentences.en: The children were unharmed and reunited with their parents.
sentences.zh: 孩子们安然无恙，并与父母团聚。

sentences.en: Samantha Azapati was charged with two counts of child stealing and with stating a false name.
